capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Wikipedia: Dual Motor 82/79 kWh gross/usable for 2025; Polestar Canada spec page: Long range Dual motor 82 kWh.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database (European MY24 Polestar 2, same 82 kWh pack): 79.0 kWh usable. Wikipedia: 79 usable / 82 gross for single 2024-25 and dual 2025.

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: NMC for all Polestar 2 packs (EV Database also NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Polestar US spec page (Performance pack car) says 400 V lithium-ion 82 kWh; same pack.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Same line as the 2024 manual: the 2024 and 2023 US Polestar 2 manuals describe only the Google Maps navigation trigger (no manual control); the 2021 manual only says preconditioning lengthens charging time. Nothing shows a change for this model year.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia spec table gives 205 kW for the 2025 Dual Motor (82 kWh); Polestar US/Canada spec pages show 205 kW for the Dual motor (Canada page: Long range Dual motor). Variant not stated individually on a Polestar page for the non-Performance trim in the US. OpenEV 150 kW is stale.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 11 kW per the Polestar US spec page for the Performance pack car and the 2023 US manual; same onboard charger.

published_10_80_min.notes: Polestar Canada spec page (Long range Dual motor): 28 min 10-80%.
